div.div: فِرَاطٌ (S, O) and ↓ فُرَاطَةٌ , like ثُمَامَةٌ, or ↓ فِرَاطَةٌ , (so in the O,) Water that is for him, of the tribes, who first arrives at it; (S, O;) water that is common property among a number of tribes, and is for him who first arrives at it: (O, K:) and in like manner the latter word applied to a well. (TA.) You say, بَيْنَ بَنِى فُلَانٍ ↓ هٰذَا مآءٌ فُرَاطَةٌ وَبَنِى فُلَانٍ, meaning, [This is water between the sons of such a one and the sons of such a one, so that] whichever of them arrives at it first waters [his beasts] and the others do not throng him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
